data.name: Azmi
data.gender_notes: Azmi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Azmi is derived from the Arabic root 'Azamah' which means 'to be steadfast, to be strong, to be trustworthy'. This name is often given to babies to signify their strength and stability, and to encourage them to be steadfast in their faith and actions. The name Azmi carries the meaning “Strong, steadfast, trustworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azmi usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, steadfast, trustworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name full of strength and resilience.
data.etymology: Azmi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, steadfast, trustworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azmi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
